caption: The drawing depicts a cylindrical metallic container with a reddish-brown and copper-colored surface, displaying subtle gradients of light and dark tones to indicate its reflective and rounded shape. Along the top rim of the container is a decorative gold border, featuring scalloped garlands and droplet-shaped details hanging down. The background is plain and beige, with no additional objects or patterns. The artist's name, "John Hall," is written in red capital letters to the right and slightly below the container. The overall composition centers the object in the middle of the image, and the lighting suggests a slight shadow cast to the left and slightly behind the container.
title: Toleware Vase
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
